title: EthXY Adventure
tagline: Next chapter of EthXY starting the Age of Adventure.  Players are able to PvP each other for rewards.
description:
Players will be able to dive down into the world of EthXY in this next chapter of the game.  Players are able to conduct battles and trades with each other.  The game has a set of collectible items that when combined, provides artifacts of power.

The game also provides a marketplace for players to swap items and collectibles.
how_its_made: Created on Base chain with account abstraction, allows for seamless onboarding of users and friction-free game interactions.  Players are able to conduct matches against each other.  The game interaction is done fully on-chain to guarantee for randomness.  We configured the site to be PWA compatible.
